name: Performing 250+ Days in One Year Changed Everything || @angadsinghranyal  | KWHS S2 Ep2
description: In this episode of Kaafi Wild Hai Show With GuptaJi, Appurv Gupta sits down with stand-up comedian Angad Singh Ranyal for an honest conversation about discipline, comedy, and constant reinvention. Angad talks about performing almost every day for over 250 days, crowd work vs solo comedy, his journey
